# Atlantis NDT

> Global NDT consulting, training, and digital twin solutions. 50+ ASNT Level III certified professionals serving oil & gas, aerospace, marine, nuclear, and power generation industries from Houston, Hyderabad, and the Middle East. ISO 9001:2015 and ASNT SNT-TC-1A compliant.

## About
Atlantis NDT is a non-destructive testing (NDT) company combining traditional inspection services (UT, RT, MT, PT, ET, VT, PAUT, TOFD) with modern technology — AI-powered NDT reporting software, 3D digital twin platforms, and an Odoo-based ERP tailored for inspection companies. Founded by ASNT Level III certified Anoop Rayavarapu, headquartered in Houston, Texas with operations in Hyderabad, India and the Middle East.

## Core Services
- [NDT Consulting](https://atlantisndt.com/consulting): Expert ASNT Level III consulting across all major NDT methods. Procedure development, code interpretation, third-party inspection.
- [NDT Consulting USA](https://atlantisndt.com/consulting-usa): Houston, Los Angeles, New Orleans, Denver, Chicago, and 20+ US cities.
- [NDT Consulting Middle East](https://atlantisndt.com/consulting-me): Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman.
- [NDT Consulting India](https://atlantisndt.com/consulting-india): Mumbai, Hyderabad, Bangalore, Chennai, Delhi.
- [NDT Training](https://atlantisndt.com/training): ASNT SNT-TC-1A Level I, II, III certification programs across all NDT methods.
- [NDT Training USA](https://atlantisndt.com/training-usa): In-person and hybrid training programs in the United States.
- [NDT Training Middle East](https://atlantisndt.com/training-me): Training centers serving GCC countries.
- [NDT Training India](https://atlantisndt.com/training-india): Hyderabad-based training with global certification.
- [Digital Twins](https://atlantisndt.com/digital-twins): Real-time 3D asset visualization with integrated NDT inspection data and AI-powered predictive maintenance.
- [Digital Twins for Oil & Gas Assets](https://atlantisndt.com/digital-twins-oil-gas-assets): Refinery, pipeline, pressure vessel, and storage tank digital twin solutions.
- [NDT Connect Marketplace](https://atlantisndt.com/ndt-connect): Marketplace connecting NDT service providers with clients across 15+ industries.
- [NDT Connect Platform](https://atlantisndt.com/ndt-connect-platform): Platform overview for service providers and inspection companies.
- [Best NDT Reporting Software 2026](https://atlantisndt.com/best-ndt-reporting-software-2026): AI-powered inspection report generation with mobile data capture.

## NDT Methods
- [NDT Methods Overview](https://atlantisndt.com/ndt-methods): All major non-destructive testing techniques compared.
- [NDT Methods Comparison](https://atlantisndt.com/ndt-methods-comparison): Side-by-side comparison of UT, RT, MT, PT, ET, VT.
- [Phased Array UT (PAUT)](https://atlantisndt.com/phased-array-ut): Advanced ultrasonic testing for welds, corrosion mapping, and complex geometries.
- [TOFD Testing](https://atlantisndt.com/tofd-testing): Time-of-Flight Diffraction for accurate flaw sizing.
- [Acoustic Emission Testing](https://atlantisndt.com/acoustic-emission-testing): Real-time monitoring of active flaws and structural integrity.
- [Eddy Current Tube Inspection](https://atlantisndt.com/eddy-current-tube-inspection): Heat exchanger and condenser tube examination.
- [Guided Wave Testing](https://atlantisndt.com/guided-wave-testing): Long-range UT for buried, insulated, and inaccessible piping.
- [Magnetic Flux Leakage Testing](https://atlantisndt.com/magnetic-flux-leakage-testing): Tank floor and pipeline corrosion screening.
- [Weld Inspection](https://atlantisndt.com/weld-inspection): Multi-method weld quality assurance.
- [Corrosion Mapping](https://atlantisndt.com/corrosion-mapping): Automated UT corrosion scanning and asset integrity.
- [Corrosion Under Insulation](https://atlantisndt.com/corrosion-under-insulation): CUI detection methods, prevention, and inspection planning.
